GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, held up passing 200m 1 length off, off heels passing 100m, clear 50m, hit line strong late # unlucky/wins?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 1kg over allotted weight. When questioned, rdr std rounding home turn he was positioned behind the two leaders and anticipated they would take him further into the race, however from the 350m he became held up on heels. Std near 150m when a run failed to open, he shifted mnt wider, however was unable to secure clear running and it was unable to be fully tested for the majority of the home straight. Over the concluding stages had to be severely checked when crowded.
